Subject: Finova procurement: PR checklist, supplier ID & marketplace options

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has everything they need to create the PR.

Summary from our call:
- You want to follow the org PR route (Coupa) rather than direct card payment.
- Estimated first-year spend (license + usage buffer): ~$72k — budgeting as a single-line subscription item.
- Procurement wants: supplier legal name, vendor form, W-9 (if applicable), and suggested PR line wording.
- Marketplace interest: you asked whether Redwood is available on any cloud marketplaces (AWS Marketplace primarily).

Action items / ask of Finova procurement:
1) Confirm preferred commercial vehicle (PO via Coupa vs Ariba vs Marketplace). You indicated Coupa is likely.
2) If using Coupa, please open a supplier request and attach our supplier packet (attached).
3) Share the internal PR/GL code mapping and cost center so we can provide suggested line items.
4) If you need a formal SOW or signature before PR submission, flag that now — we can route DocuSign.

What I’m attaching for you and procurement: PR_Template_Finova.xlsx (PR-ready line item suggestion) and Coupa_Supplier_Request_Form.pdf (pre-filled where possible).

Short guidance for the supplier request (high level):
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address: 1201 Market St, Suite 700, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Tax ID: 94-XXXXXXX (we'll provide official copy of W-9 once you confirm procurement route)
- Suggested PR description: "Annual Redwood Inference LLM inference platform subscription — Base seats + variable usage (estimate)"
- Suggested GL code line: Software Subscriptions / Cloud Services — please confirm with your finance team.

Marketplace note: we do maintain an AWS Marketplace listing in many regions; listing status can speed PO approval in some orgs. If Finova prefers marketplace billing, let us know and we’ll confirm whether your account is eligible and share the marketplace SKUs.

Next steps from our side:
- Marissa will send a short supplier packet with the Coupa steps and a pre-filled supplier request form.
- Sean will open a HubSpot task and coordinate finance for any expedited processing.

If procurement prefers, we can also provide a one-page procurement checklist to paste into your PR system. Thanks — I’ll follow up in 24 hours unless I hear otherwise.

Best,

Hi Olivia / Procurement team — copying procurement ops guidance below and attaching the two forms you requested.

Short supplier onboarding checklist (Coupa / Ariba):
- Step 1: Open supplier request in Coupa. Attach: supplier W-9 (if US entity), supplier request form (attached), and our remit address.
- Step 2: Finance will create an internal supplier ID (please share the created ID back to us).
- Step 3: Create PR with 2 lines:
  • Line 1 (Subscription): Redwood Inference annual subscription — SKU RDW-ANNUAL-2026 — Qty 1 — Amount $60,000 — GL: 5601 (Software Subscriptions)
  • Line 2 (Estimated usage buffer): Variable usage overage — Amount $12,000 (estimate) — GL: 5605 (Cloud Usage)
- Step 4: Add payment terms: Net 30 and ACH details if you require — we can provide bank details once supplier ID is issued.

Supplier details to populate request form: 
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- DBA (if requested): Redwood Inference
- Remit address: 1201 Market St, Suite 700, San Francisco, CA 94103
- FEIN: 94-XXXXXXX (we will provide completed W-9 PDF on signature)
- Primary contact for invoicing: invoices@redwood.ai

Coupa-specific notes: many customers prefer to include a supporting doc or one-page SOW in the "attachments" field in Coupa to help approvers. If Finova's Coupa instance enforces supplier vetting, select "Requestor registers supplier" and attach Coupa_Supplier_Request_Form.pdf (attached).

Ariba notes: if Finova prefers Ariba, the supplier registration process is similar; the key is to get the supplier ID back to us so we can map billing and tax info.

Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace in the US (SKU RDW-MP-STD-001). Marketplace billing is supported but often requires a separate procurement path to link your AWS account to the contract — procurement teams sometimes prefer this route because it centralizes cloud spend. If you want marketplace, we can confirm whether Finova’s AWS account will be eligible and share the exact SKU and pricing terms.

Attachments included: PR_Template_Finova.xlsx (proposal-ready PR lines), Coupa_Supplier_Request_Form.pdf (pre-filled).

Internal note (Marissa -> Finance/Rev Ops): Please create an internal ticket to finance to provision supplier ID once Finova submits the Coupa request. I will also attach our W-9 and vendor packet to the hub doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/supplier-packet/finova (internal).

Let me know if you need any edits to the line item wording.

Thanks,
